description: Defines the ShoppingCartAttribute class representing attributes of a shopping cart item, including option and attribute IDs, names, and values.

classes.name: ShoppingCartAttribute
classes.description: Entity class that extends ShopEntity, encapsulating shopping cart attribute data such as option IDs, attribute IDs, and their names/values.

methods.name: getOptionId
methods.description: Returns the option ID associated with the shopping cart attribute.

methods.name: setOptionId
methods.description: Sets the option ID for the shopping cart attribute.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the option.

methods.name: setOptionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the option.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the option.

methods.name: setOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the option.
